sources.title: Classical scale-separated AdS$_3$ vacua in heterotic string theory

evidence.text: Can heterotic compactifications produce supersymmetric AdS3 vacua with quantized fluxes, stabilized geometric moduli, weak coupling, large internal volume and parametric separation between internal and AdS length scales?

Neither the inherited surviving parameters nor the limited diagnostics settle the full KK gap or a no-go theorem.

destinations.title: Do independently adjustable geometric parameters in supersymmetric massive-IIA AdS₄×S²(B₄) vacua permit scale separation after flux quantisation, and what can curvature ratios and a test-scalar KK spectrum establish?

Can Maldacena–Nuñez-type restrictions on Minkowski and de Sitter flux vacua also obstruct AdS vacua whose KK masses are parametrically above the cosmological curvature scale? What would this imply for classical Romans-mass smoothing of O6 singularities?

Do apparent violations of AdS/KK scale separation and the strong AdS distance conjecture in selected type II flux EFTs survive when the internal geometry, its flux-dependent normalization, and the lightest KK directions are included?
Does supersymmetry force a KK tower to track AdS curvature in every small-cosmological-constant limit? The paper tests this conjectural restriction using the localized continuation of DGKT vacua.

Does the KK tower decouple from AdS curvature as the cosmological constant approaches zero? The diagnostic compares a squared KK mass with curvature, normalized consistently in the lower-dimensional theory.
Which flux equations admit additional controlled scaling directions that change the KK/AdS hierarchy? Are orientifold sources necessary for such directions in string flux vacua?

Can source-free type-IIA product backgrounds containing AdS2 exhibit parametrically separated compactification scales, and how do curvature bounds, Ricci-flat factors and flux quantization constrain that possibility?
Can an unconstrained flux parameter produce controlled AdS scale separation in a four-dimensional type IIA model?
Can the Kaluza-Klein scale become parametrically larger than the AdS6 curvature scale in these backgrounds?
Can internal excitations remain parametrically heavier than the AdS curvature scale while the compactification stays at weak coupling and large volume?

Do internal directions carrying only D-brane contributions obstruct geometries favorable to scale separation? The proposed relation connects source orientations, geometric AdS compatibility, and possible scale hierarchies.

Can independent scalings of the three unconstrained F₄ flux components produce anisotropic, scale-separated AdS₄ vacua with large internal subvolumes and weak coupling? The paper also studies interpolation between scaling regimes and the associated field-space distance.

Can string compactifications admit controlled infinite families of AdS vacua with parametrically decoupled extra dimensions, consistently with source localisation, higher-dimensional embeddings, Swampland conjectures and holography?

What is the complete KK spectrum of chiral gauged six-dimensional Salam–Sezgin supergravity on AdS3×squashed S3, and can its supersymmetric or nonsupersymmetric families exhibit parametric scale separation without orientifolds?

When does a leading orientifold contribution force separation between the overall Kaluza–Klein mass and the external curvature scale, and which type II flux setups can support parametrically controlled vacua?
